newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: N.Korean navy patrol ship strays south - ministry.
newsitem.headline: N.Korean navy patrol ship strays south - ministry.

text.p: A North Korean naval patrol vessel intruded into South Korean waters on Thursday, a defence ministry official said.
The official said he could not comment on a report by Yonhap Television News that the Northern vessel fired three shots at South Korean navy ships.
The official said a statement on the incident would be issued shortly.
Yonhap said the patrol vessel crossed the nautical demarcation line off the west coast of the Korean peninsula, fired three shots at the Southern ships and stayed for about one hour before returning.
The demarcation line that bisects the Korean peninsula -- and extends into coastal waters -- is a legacy of the 1950-53 Korean War, which ended in a truce.
Exactly one week ago, a Northern naval ship intruded South, but South Korean authorities said at the time they believed it was a mistake. No shots were fired.
